hoh.quote: Chart J: For persons filing jointly, head of household, or qualifying surviving spouse.

mfs.quote: Use Chart S if your filing status is single or married filing separately.

hoh.quote: Chart J: For persons filing jointly, head of household, or qualifying surviving spouse—If your taxable income is $50,000 or more but not over $250,000 your tax is $3,756 plus 8.75% of excess over $50,000. If your taxable income is over $250,000 your tax is $21,256 plus 9.9% of excess over $250,000.

mfs.quote: Chart S: For persons filing single or married filing separately—If your taxable income is $50,000 or more but not over $125,000 your tax is $4,065 plus 8.75% of excess over $50,000. If your taxable income is over $125,000 your tax is $10,627 plus 9.9% of excess over $125,000.

hoh.quote: Chart J: Married filing jointly, Head of household, or Qualifying surviving spouse—Not over $9,100, 4.75% of taxable income. Over $9,100 but not over $22,800, $432 plus 6.75% of excess over $9,100. Over $22,800 but not over $250,000, $1,357 plus 8.75% of excess over $22,800. Over $250,000, $21,237 plus 9.9% of excess over $250,000.

mfs.quote: Chart S: Single or Married filing separately—Not over $4,550, 4.75% of taxable income. Over $4,550 but not over $11,400, $216 plus 6.75% of excess over $4,550. Over $11,400 but not over $125,000, $678 plus 8.75% of excess over $11,400. Over $125,000, $10,618 plus 9.9% of excess over $125,000.

deduction_mfs.quote: If spouse claims the standard deduction, married filing separately uses the single standard deduction.
